The knight of iron. A thing that has waited a thousand years for one man. After a big swing of its axe, its back is open. Aim for that gap. Open the Memory Gate and fight it. Bring it down and… maybe we'll learn who it was waiting for.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the knight of iron.

A crest engraved inside the helmet. The Order of the Flame Knights. And one line. 'Until the lord of the flame brand returns.' …Twenty years ago we called this knight a 'monster.' It was only waiting for its master. Like me.
Twenty years. This time I'll stand before the door.

I followed the path drawn on the iron knight's helmet, and it led to the Order's old trial grounds, the Spiral Abyss. Clear the first floor and you're a full member of the Order. And… they say the Abyss shows the memories of those who passed through. The expedition twenty years ago passed through it too.
Clear floor 1 of the Spiral Abyss.

What did you see in the Abyss? …The expedition's last night? A man called Kael handing something to Captain Roran? And you couldn't see what came after. Don't tell the captain yet. Not until he brings it up himself.

Two men by a campfire.
"Roran, take this with you. You have to go back."

The second mark is a dark forest. At night glowing things called lanterns drift there. They say they lure the lost into the swamp. Twenty years ago Marco followed that light. Kill them and they drop glowing jelly. Gather it. It'll light the way when we look for Marco.
Defeat 5 lanterns in the dark forest and bring 4 glowing jelly.
You shone the jelly light and found a name tag stuck in a tree trunk. …Marco. He wasn't lost. He was leaving marks on the trees as he walked. Hoping we'd follow.

Marco's marks lead into the southern jungle. Foliaaths live there. Man-eating flowers that hide in the vines and then open their mouths. You don't see them until you're close. Clear the area near the marks. Kael's old campsite rock is in that jungle.
Words scratched into the rock with a blade? 'Roran, the southern sun is calling us. You go north.' …Kael already meant to stay behind alone back then. I didn't know.
Things fly over the seaside cliffs. Nagas. Winged sea serpents. They spit venom. Twenty years ago they got Ines. Bring me their fangs. I want to offer Ines… a dagger made from their fangs.
Defeat 2 nagas on the seaside cliffs and bring 2 naga fangs.
(Roran whittles the fangs into a dagger.) Ines was the bravest of the expedition. Went at them with a single dagger. …There was a name tag at the foot of that cliff? Thank you.

I heard Roran's expedition is heading north into the snowfields. Good timing. To stand against fire you need a cold that can put fire to sleep. They say the ice giant sleeping in the snowfields carries such a crystal. First find where the giant sleeps.
Find where the ice giant of the snowfields sleeps.
You found it. The giant is in a deep sleep. …Tell Roran something for me. Tell him not to look for Kael's sword in the snowfields. He won't find it.
There are three marks in the snowfields. Strays wandering in the blizzard… some of them might be my people. If one is wearing our gear, find its name tag.
…Only one? Marco's older brother, Danilo. The snow must have taken the other two. It's all right. Even one.

Surveyor, the captain has collapsed! He was caught in a blizzard on the very spot where he lost his people twenty years ago. He's freezing, but he won't move. He says 'if I wait here, it feels like they'll come back.' Please bring him a campfire and warm food. Please.
Bring 1 campfire and 6 cooked beef to the fallen Captain Roran.

(Roran barely warms his hands at the fire.) …It was like this twenty years ago. No one to light a fire, and we lost three. This time there's a fire. Because you're here. …Let's go get the giant. This time I'm not the one who waits.
The Giant Who Holds the Ice

Defeat the Frostmaw and bring me its ice crystal. Fight beyond the Memory Gate and you won't be swept up in the snowfield avalanches. When it draws a breath, the ice breath is coming. Dodge to the side. That crystal will one day be used… at a very important moment.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Frostmaw.
The crystal trembles in my hand. It senses fire. Keep it safe. Never sell it. …There was no sword in the giant's nest, was there? I thought as much.
This time I'm not the one who waits.
Say you slipped the crystal away while the giant slept.
Say you won it in a fair fight.

The next mark on the map is a monastery on a high mountaintop. The Chronicle mentions 'the stonemason who carved the seals into stone.' The Sculptor. The captain… couldn't climb that mountain. He lost two people on it twenty years ago.
You're ready to meet the stonemason. They say his trial tests balance, not strength. The captain says he'll wait at the foot of the mountain. He didn't come up.

…I'm not going up. Twenty years ago I lost two on that mountain. They fell from the Sculptor's pillar. I told them 'climb.' And I just watched from below. If I stand in that spot again… I feel like I'll send someone up again.
(Isabel puts a hand on Roran's shoulder.) "You're not sending us up, Captain. We're the ones climbing." …Right. Then this time I'll hold the rope from below. If you fall, I'll catch you.
Captain Roran: Their names were Hayun and Otto. Otto had a fine singing voice.
Captain Roran: When Hayun fell, she looked at me. It wasn't a look of blame. That's even worse.
Captain Roran: …You come back. Promise me that much.
Pass the Sculptor's trial. Climb the rising pillar without losing your balance. Fall and you start over. When you finish, the stonemason will tell you something.

"The seals are not seven but eight. The eighth stone bears no name." …The Sculptor said that? My mother's page also said 'the eighth seat is empty.' And there were two name tags beneath the trial pillar? Tell the captain. Tell him I climbed the mountain.

The seals are not seven but eight.
The eighth stone bears no name.
The Beast That Howls at the Moon

Every night a beast howls in the southern grasslands. The Elokosa. They say it howls with a different voice as the moon waxes and wanes. Twenty years ago Kael raised one of its pups. Rumor says it carries Kael's scarf in its jaws. Fight it in the open and the pack comes. Call it alone through the Memory Gate.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Elokosa Howler.
(Roran grips a worn scarf.) It's Kael's. That beast carried it for twenty years. Waiting for its master. …This forest is full of things that wait. The scarf smells of the sun. South.
Find the sun tribe's grove in the southern savanna. Masked warriors are raiding the villages. Swift raptor warriors among them. Among them… look for a masked priest. Don't kill him rashly.
Find the Umvuthana grove and defeat 6 masked warriors and 1 raptor warrior.
They were shouting 'the second sun'? And the priest called my name? …It's Kael.
The tribe has priests who dance like cranes and heal the warriors. Cranes. As long as they sing, the warriors won't fall. Stop the priests first. Kael is bound by that song.
